channel.title: The Awesome Ledger — free-for-dev
channel.description: New entries across the GitHub awesome ecosystem, diffed nightly.

item.title: The Network Tools — via free-for-dev
item.description: Automated domain and network infrastructure monitoring: scheduled DNS health, SSL certificate expiry, and email security (SPF/DKIM/DMARC) checks with public API and MCP server. Free tier includes 3 monitored domains, webhooks, and 100 req/min API.

item.title: IPDatum — via free-for-dev
item.description: IPv4/IPv6 geolocation, ASN, and 12-signal VPN/proxy/Tor/cloud/anycast classification API with confidence radius. Free tier includes 1,000 requests/day without signup or 50,000 requests/day with a free API key (batch up to 100 IPs).

item.title: TCM Academy Free Tier — via free-for-dev
item.description: Free, full six course tier with over 40 hours of training for IT beginners.

item.title: SharpSkill — via free-for-dev
item.description: Free tier of a technical interview preparation platform including cheatsheets, flashcards, tests and code review exercises in 20 technologies, plus public job market data by technology and country.

item.title: Pingaroo — via free-for-dev
item.description: 1 website, 2 URLs, uptime check with 15 minutes interval, SSL/DNS/domain checks, email alerts, no credit card needed.

item.title: CodePeel — via free-for-dev
item.description: Automated code reviews for GitHub pull requests that catch bugs and open fix PRs. Free forever for unlimited public and private repositories (30 reviews/month).

item.title: BuildPulse — via free-for-dev
item.description: Faster runners for GitHub Actions, CircleCI and Semaphore. 3,000 free minutes every month, no credit card required.

item.title: 12happy — via free-for-dev
item.description: Free uptime service monitoring with status page for your product. Apps for both iOS and Android, notifications via Slack, Telegram and E-mail. Various locations. Free plan includes 50 monitors checked every 5 minutes.

item.title: TemplateFox — via free-for-dev
item.description: PDF generation API with a visual template editor, dynamic data merging, and SDKs for 7 languages. Free plan includes 60 PDFs/month and 3 templates.

item.title: Hotjar — via free-for-dev
item.description: Website Analytics and Reports . Free Plan allows 2000 pageviews/day. One hundred snapshots/day (max capacity: 300). Three snapshot heatmaps can be stored for 365 days. Unlimited Team Members. Also in App and standalone surveys, feedback widgets with screenshots. Free tier allows creating 3 surveys & 3 feedback widgets and collecting 20 responses per month.

item.title: Buttondown — via free-for-dev
item.description: Newsletter service. Up to 100 subscribers free

item.title: BetaLobby — via free-for-dev
item.description: Closed testing platform for Android developers to distribute pre-release Google Play builds across 16-developer teams, verify installs, and track 14-day daily check-ins to meet the 12-tester production requirement. Free, no paid plans.

item.title: Google Kubernetes Engine — via free-for-dev
item.description: No cluster management fee for one zonal cluster. Each user node is charged at standard Compute Engine pricing

item.title: Compute Engine — via free-for-dev
item.description: 1 non-preemptible e2-micro, 30GB HDD, 5GB snapshot storage (restricted to certain regions), 1 GB network egress from North America to all region destinations (excluding China and Australia) per month

item.title: Cloud Storage — via free-for-dev
item.description: 5GB, 1GB network egress

item.title: Cloud Shell — via free-for-dev
item.description: Web-based Linux shell/primary IDE with 5GB of persistent storage. 60-hour limit per week

item.title: Cloud Run — via free-for-dev
item.description: 2 million requests per month, 360,000 GB-seconds memory, 180,000 vCPU-seconds of compute time, 1 GB network egress from North America per month

item.title: Cloud Pub/Sub — via free-for-dev
item.description: 10GB of messages per month

item.title: Cloud Functions — via free-for-dev
item.description: 2 million invocations per month (includes both background and HTTP invocations)

item.title: Cloud Firestore — via free-for-dev
item.description: 1GB storage, 50,000 reads, 20,000 writes, 20,000 deletes per day

item.title: Cloud Build — via free-for-dev
item.description: 120 build-minutes per day

item.title: BigQuery — via free-for-dev
item.description: 1 TB of querying per month, 10 GB of storage each month

item.title: App Engine — via free-for-dev
item.description: 28 frontend instance hours per day, nine backend instance hours per day

item.title: turboSMTP — via free-for-dev
item.description: SMTP relay service, free for 200 emails per day or 6000 emails per month, free forever, no time limit, no expiry. Web API, SPF/DKIM authentication, suppression management, 1 sending domain, 2 API keys, 2FA, ticket and chat support, GDPR compliant.

item.title: Kwes.io — via free-for-dev
item.description: Feature rich form endpoint. Works great with static sites. The free plan includes up to 1 website with up to 50 monthly submissions.

item.title: IFTTT — via free-for-dev
item.description: Automate your favorite apps and devices. Free 2 Applets

item.title: Fibery — via free-for-dev
item.description: Connected workspace platform. Free for single users, up to 2 GB disk space.

item.title: DeepSource — via free-for-dev
item.description: DeepSource continuously analyzes source code changes, finding and fixing issues categorized under security, performance, anti-patterns, bug-risks, documentation, and style. Native integration with GitHub, GitLab, and Bitbucket.

item.title: CurrencyBeacon — via free-for-dev
item.description: Realtime currency data API for fintech apps. The free plan includes 5,000 calls per month.

item.title: CrateDB — via free-for-dev
item.description: Distributed Open Source SQL database for real-time analytics. Free Tier CRFREE: One-node with 2 CPUs, 2 GiB of memory, 8 GiB of storage. One cluster per organization, no payment method needed.

item.title: Context.dev — via free-for-dev
item.description: Web scraping API with 1,000 API credits per month (1,000 standard scrapes) plus 10,000 one-time Logo Link requests, no credit card required.

item.title: Upstream — via free-for-dev
item.description: Over 10,000 pushes/sec, the fastest Git host. 100 free repos, public or private, with LFS, merge checks, semantic code search, and AI

item.title: FormTango — via free-for-dev
item.description: Form backend for static sites and AI-built apps. Free plan: 100 submissions a month, unlimited forms, spam filtering and email notifications. Endpoints can be created from the API with no account.

item.title: v0 — via free-for-dev
item.description: Created by Vercel, v0 generates copy-and-paste friendly React code using shadcn/ui and Tailwind CSS. The free plan includes 7 messages per day, Design Mode and GitHub sync.

item.title: tridentstack.com — via free-for-dev
item.description: Patch, vulnerability and compliance management for Windows, macOS and Linux endpoints. Free forever for up to 200 endpoints with every feature included, no credit card required.

item.title: Uptimeify — via free-for-dev
item.description: Permament free status pages including custom domain, subscribers (mail, slack, teams, webhook and rss) and maintenance with postmortems. Fully hosted inside the EU.

item.title: Umso — via free-for-dev
item.description: Generate, edit, and publish beautiful websites and landing pages for your startup, all without code. The free plan covers one site with a homepage, blog and free subdomain, with Umso branding.

item.title: Tigris — via free-for-dev
item.description: S3-compatible object storage with no egress fees. The free tier includes 5 GB of storage, 10,000 write requests and 100,000 read requests per month, with no card required.

item.title: Safety — via free-for-dev
item.description: Software supply chain security for Python, JavaScript and Docker dependencies. The free plan covers one codebase and 100 scans per month for a single user, for non-commercial use.

item.title: Respan — via free-for-dev
item.description: LLM observability and gateway with one format for 200+ models. The free plan includes 100,000 logs, 1,000 scores, five datasets, two evaluators and ten prompts per month, with no credit card required.

item.title: Ravion — via free-for-dev
item.description: Deploy web services, databases, and more on your own AWS account with a Git push style workflow. The Individuals plan is free for one user with up to 50 modules, 2,000 pipeline minutes and $20 of AI tokens per month. AWS costs are billed through AWS, but you can use credits and the AWS free tier.

item.title: QRdx — via free-for-dev
item.description: Free Open-source QR code generator, plus an image API that needs no key (SVG, PNG, WebP or EPS). Free: unlimited static QR codes with no account, the image API up to 300 requests a minute, and 10 dynamic QR codes with scan analytics on a free account.

item.title: Lyssna — via free-for-dev
item.description: Test designs and mockups on real people and track visitors. The free plan includes unlimited quick studies, three seats and 15 self-recruited test or survey responses.

item.title: Kardinal — via free-for-dev
item.description: Route optimization API for delivery and field service fleets: multi-vehicle routing with time windows, vehicle capacities and other real-world constraints, also usable by AI agents. Free tier includes 1,000 stops that never expire, no credit card required.

item.title: Fivetran — via free-for-dev
item.description: Reverse ETL & Operational Analytics Platform. Sync 10 fields from your data warehouse to 60+ SaaS like Salesforce, Zendesk, or Amplitude.

item.title: Chainguard — via free-for-dev
item.description: Hardened, minimal container images and a software supply chain security platform. The Starter plan is free with no credit card: five users, five container images, 50,000 dependency pulls and 100 GB of artifact storage per month.

item.title: Better Stack Logs — via free-for-dev
item.description: ClickHouse-based SQL-compatible log management. The free plan includes 3 GB of logs retained for three days.

item.title: Autumn — via free-for-dev
item.description: Billing infrastructure for SaaS: pricing models, entitlements, usage tracking and checkout. The free plan includes 25,000 in monthly billing volume, 10,000 customers and 10 million API requests.

item.title: proofline.sh — via free-for-dev
item.description: AI code review for GitHub pull requests, with infrastructure-aware checks when connected to a deployment environment. Free forever for open repos, and no subscription required if you BYOK on any private repo.

item.title: zoom — via free-for-dev
item.description: Secure Video and Web conferencing add-ons available. The free plan is limited to 40 minutes.
